items.text: 1 a Alkanes are saturated hydrocarbons. Explain the term saturated.

items.label: list_item
items.text: b Undecane is an alkane with 11 carbon atoms.

items.label: list_item
items.text: i Write down the molecular formula for undecane.

items.label: list_item
items.text: iiWhat physical state (solid, liquid or gas) would you expect undecane to be in at room temperature (25 °C)?

items.label: list_item
items.text: iii Write a balanced chemical equation for the complete combustion of undecane.

items.label: list_item
items.text: iv Write a balanced chemical equation for the incomplete combustion of undecane to produce carbon monoxide and explain why this reaction is harmful to humans.
